ABOUT

The role of humanity without gods is a topic still passionately argued. Almost every citizen loves a vigorous debate, and this tendency has given rise to an entire class of wandering philosophers who journey from town to town to trade ideas and espouse theories. Some even journey overseas, hoping to teach outsiders the value of self-reliance and the foolishness of worship.
